observation.command:
cd /workspace
/workspace/.venv/bin/python << 'EOF'
import re
txt=open('process-compose.yaml').read()
# split into top-level processes: entries are '  name:' at 2-space indent under 'processes:'
blocks=re.split(r'\n  (?=\S):', txt)
res=[]
for b in blocks:
    nm=re.search(r'^(\S+):', b)
    if not nm: continue
    name=nm.group(1)
    cmd=re.search(r'--port (\d+)', b)
    wd=re.search(r'working_dir:\s*(\S+)', b)
    port=int(cmd.group(1)) if cmd else None
    res.append((name, port, wd.group(1) if wd else ''))
for name,port,wd in sorted(res,key=lambda x:(x[1] or 999)):
    if port and 18000<=port<=18016:
        print(f'{port}: {name:28s} {wd}')
EOF
